## Azure Policy Search

Enter text in **Search text** to search Policy Definitions and Initiatives visible in the selected Azure Resource Graph scope. Use **Resource type** and **Effect** to narrow Policy Definition results. The results use the permissions of the signed-in workbook viewer.

parameters.name: SearchText
parameters.label: Search text
parameters.description: Search policy names, display names, descriptions, and definition JSON.

parameters.name: ResourceTypeFilter
parameters.label: Resource type
parameters.description: Filter Policy Definitions by resource type. Leave empty to show all.
parameters.query: policyresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/policydefinitions' | extend ResourceType = tostring(properties.policyRule.if.allOf[0].equals) | extend ResourceType = iff(isempty(ResourceType), tostring(properties.policyRule.if.equals), ResourceType) | extend ResourceType = tolower(ResourceType) | where isnotempty(ResourceType) | distinct ResourceType | project value = ResourceType, label = ResourceType | order by label asc

parameters.name: EffectFilter
parameters.label: Effect
parameters.description: Filter Policy Definitions by effect. Leave empty to show all.
parameters.query: policyresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/policydefinitions' | extend EffectRaw = tostring(properties.policyRule.then.effect) | extend EffectParameterName = extract(@"parameters\('([^']+)'\)", 1, EffectRaw) | extend EffectParameter = properties.parameters[EffectParameterName] | extend AllowedEffects = tostring(EffectParameter.allowedValues) | extend DefaultEffect = tostring(EffectParameter.defaultValue) | extend Effect = case(isempty(EffectRaw), '', isempty(EffectParameterName), tolower(EffectRaw), isnotempty(AllowedEffects) and AllowedEffects != '[]', tolower(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(AllowedEffects, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', '')), isnotempty(DefaultEffect), tolower(DefaultEffect), tolower(EffectRaw)) | where isnotempty(Effect) | mv-expand Effect = split(Effect, ',') | extend Effect = trim(' ', tostring(Effect)) | where isnotempty(Effect) | distinct Effect | project value = Effect, label = Effect | order by label asc

content.query:
policyresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/policydefinitions'
| extend DisplayName = tostring(properties.displayName), Description = tostring(properties.description)
| extend DefinitionJson = tostring(properties)
| where isempty('{SearchText}') or name contains '{SearchText}' or DisplayName contains '{SearchText}' or Description contains '{SearchText}' or DefinitionJson contains '{SearchText}'
| where DisplayName !contains '[Deprecated]'
| extend EffectRaw = tostring(properties.policyRule.then.effect)
| extend EffectParameterName = extract(@"parameters\('([^']+)'\)", 1, EffectRaw)
| extend EffectParameter = properties.parameters[EffectParameterName]
| extend AllowedEffects = tostring(EffectParameter.allowedValues)
| extend DefaultEffect = tostring(EffectParameter.defaultValue)
| extend Effect = case(isempty(EffectRaw), '', isempty(EffectParameterName), tolower(EffectRaw), isnotempty(AllowedEffects) and AllowedEffects != '[]', tolower(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(AllowedEffects, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', '')), isnotempty(DefaultEffect), tolower(DefaultEffect), tolower(EffectRaw))
| extend ResourceType = tostring(properties.policyRule.if.allOf[0].equals)
| extend ResourceType = iff(isempty(ResourceType), tostring(properties.policyRule.if.equals), ResourceType)
| extend ResourceType = tolower(ResourceType)
| where isempty('{ResourceTypeFilter}') or ResourceType =~ '{ResourceTypeFilter}'
| extend SelectedEffects = dynamic([{EffectFilter}])
| extend EffectValues = split(Effect, ',')
| where array_length(SelectedEffects) == 0 or array_length(set_intersect(EffectValues, SelectedEffects)) > 0
| extend PortalUrl = strcat('https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Policy/PolicyDetailBlade/definitionId/', url_encode_component(id))
| project Details = 'Details', DisplayName, ResourceType, Effect, PolicyType = tostring(properties.policyType), Description, PortalUrl
| order by DisplayName asc
content.title: Policy definitions

content.query:
policyresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.authorization/policysetdefinitions'
| extend DisplayName = tostring(properties.displayName), Description = tostring(properties.description)
| extend DefinitionJson = tostring(properties)
| where isempty('{SearchText}') or name contains '{SearchText}' or DisplayName contains '{SearchText}' or Description contains '{SearchText}' or DefinitionJson contains '{SearchText}'
| where DisplayName !contains '[Deprecated]'
| extend PortalUrl = strcat('https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Policy/InitiativeDetailBlade/id/', url_encode_component(id))
| project DisplayName, PolicyType = tostring(properties.policyType), Description, PortalUrl
| order by DisplayName asc
content.title: Policy initiatives
